columns: answered_at timestamp with time zone null
created_at timestamp with time zone = now()
constraints: ck_access_requests_status: CHECK (((status)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('open'::character varying)::text, ('granted'::character varying)::text, ('declined'::character varying)::text, ('revoked'::character varying)::text])))
fk_access_requests_engagement: FOREIGN KEY (engagement_id) REFERENCES delivery.engagements(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
pk_access_requests: PRIMARY KEY (id)

columns: issued_at timestamp with time zone = now()
mailed_at timestamp with time zone null
signed_at timestamp with time zone null
constraints: ck_agreements_signed: CHECK ((((signed_at IS NULL) = (signer_name IS NULL)) AND ((signed_at IS NULL) = (signer_email IS NULL))))
fk_agreements_engagement: FOREIGN KEY (engagement_id) REFERENCES delivery.engagements(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
fk_agreements_terms_version_terms_versions: FOREIGN KEY (terms_version) REFERENCES pipeline.terms_versions(id)
pk_agreements: PRIMARY KEY (id)
uq_agreements_engagement: UNIQUE (engagement_id)

columns: answered_at timestamp with time zone null
created_at timestamp with time zone = now()
constraints: fk_asks_engagement: FOREIGN KEY (engagement_id) REFERENCES delivery.engagements(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
fk_asks_milestone: FOREIGN KEY (milestone_id) REFERENCES delivery.milestones(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
pk_asks: PRIMARY KEY (id)

columns: created_at timestamp with time zone = now()
constraints: ck_comments_on: CHECK ((num_nonnulls(update_id, deliverable_id) = 1))
fk_comments_deliverable: FOREIGN KEY (deliverable_id) REFERENCES delivery.deliverables(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
fk_comments_engagement: FOREIGN KEY (engagement_id) REFERENCES delivery.engagements(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
fk_comments_update: FOREIGN KEY (update_id) REFERENCES delivery.updates(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
pk_comments: PRIMARY KEY (id)

columns: addressed timestamp with time zone null
cleared timestamp with time zone null
raised timestamp with time zone null
rated timestamp with time zone null
updated timestamp with time zone null
at timestamp with time zone null
created_at timestamp with time zone = now()
decided_at timestamp with time zone null
constraints: ck_deliverables_kind: CHECK (((kind)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('file'::character varying)::text, ('link'::character varying)::text, ('loom'::character varying)::text, ('doc'::character varying)::text])))
ck_deliverables_status: CHECK (((status)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('waiting'::character varying)::text, ('approved'::character varying)::text, ('changes'::character varying)::text])))
ck_deliverables_where: CHECK (((url IS NOT NULL) OR (file_key IS NOT NULL)))
fk_deliverables_engagement: FOREIGN KEY (engagement_id) REFERENCES delivery.engagements(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
fk_deliverables_milestone: FOREIGN KEY (milestone_id) REFERENCES delivery.milestones(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
fk_deliverables_previous: FOREIGN KEY (previous_id) REFERENCES delivery.deliverables(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
pk_deliverables: PRIMARY KEY (id)

columns: created_at timestamp with time zone = now()
constraints: ck_engagements_source_channel: CHECK (((source_channel)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('email'::character varying)::text, ('sms'::character varying)::text, ('ads'::character varying)::text, ('content'::character varying)::text, ('search'::character varying)::text, ('reach'::character varying)::text])))

ck_engagements_status: CHECK (((status)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('onboarding'::character varying)::text, ('active'::character varying)::text, ('paused'::character varying)::text, ('done'::character varying)::text])))
fk_engagements_client: FOREIGN KEY (client_id) REFERENCES clients(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
pk_engagements: PRIMARY KEY (id)

columns: at timestamp with time zone = now()
constraints: pk_flag_digests: PRIMARY KEY (day)

columns: addressed_at timestamp with time zone null
clear_fired_at timestamp with time zone null
cleared_at timestamp with time zone null
raise_fired_at timestamp with time zone null
raised_at timestamp with time zone = now()
told_at timestamp with time zone null
constraints: ck_flags_remind: CHECK (((remind_days >= 1) AND (remind_days <= 90)))
ck_flags_side: CHECK (((side)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('risk'::character varying)::text, ('opportunity'::character varying)::text])))

ck_flags_source: CHECK (((source)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('delivery'::character varying)::text, ('health'::character varying)::text, ('workflows'::character varying)::text, ('person'::character varying)::text])))
fk_flags_client: FOREIGN KEY (client_id) REFERENCES clients(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
fk_flags_engagement: FOREIGN KEY (engagement_id) REFERENCES delivery.engagements(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
pk_flags: PRIMARY KEY (id)

columns: at timestamp with time zone = now()
constraints: ck_health_days_band: CHECK (((band)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('healthy'::character varying)::text, ('watch'::character varying)::text, ('risk'::character varying)::text, ('none'::character varying)::text])))
fk_health_days_client: FOREIGN KEY (client_id) REFERENCES clients(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
pk_health_days: PRIMARY KEY (client_id, day)

columns: at timestamp with time zone = now()
cleared_at timestamp with time zone null
constraints: ck_health_overrides_score: CHECK (((score >= 0) AND (score <= 100)))
fk_health_overrides_client: FOREIGN KEY (client_id) REFERENCES clients(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
pk_health_overrides: PRIMARY KEY (id)

columns: at timestamp with time zone = now()
constraints: ck_health_ratings_score: CHECK (((score >= 1) AND (score <= 5)))
fk_health_ratings_client: FOREIGN KEY (client_id) REFERENCES clients(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
pk_health_ratings: PRIMARY KEY (id)

columns: at timestamp with time zone = now()
told_at timestamp with time zone null
constraints: fk_interests_engagement: FOREIGN KEY (engagement_id) REFERENCES delivery.engagements(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
pk_interests: PRIMARY KEY (id)
uq_interests_offer: UNIQUE (engagement_id, offer_id, email)

columns: created_at timestamp with time zone = now()
mailed_at timestamp with time zone null
reminded_at timestamp with time zone null
constraints: ck_invoices_cents: CHECK ((cents > 0))
ck_invoices_currency: CHECK (((currency)::text ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$'::text))
ck_invoices_dispute: CHECK (((dispute)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('open'::character varying)::text, ('won'::character varying)::text, ('lost'::character varying)::text])))
ck_invoices_paid: CHECK ((((status)::text = 'paid'::text) = (paid_on IS NOT NULL)))
ck_invoices_received: CHECK ((received_cents >= 0))
ck_invoices_refunded: CHECK (((refunded_cents >= 0) AND (refunded_cents <= cents)))
ck_invoices_status: CHECK (((status)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('open'::character varying)::text, ('paid'::character varying)::text, ('void'::character varying)::text])))
fk_invoices_engagement: FOREIGN KEY (engagement_id) REFERENCES delivery.engagements(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
pk_invoices: PRIMARY KEY (id)
uq_invoices_number: UNIQUE (number)

columns: told_through timestamp with time zone null
constraints: ck_member_mail_level: CHECK (((level)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('all'::character varying)::text, ('digest'::character varying)::text, ('off'::character varying)::text])))
fk_member_mail_member: FOREIGN KEY (client_id, email) REFERENCES client_members(client_id, email) ON DELETE CASCADE
pk_member_mail: PRIMARY KEY (client_id, email)
fk_milestones_engagement: FOREIGN KEY (engagement_id) REFERENCES delivery.engagements(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
pk_milestones: PRIMARY KEY (id)
uq_milestones_key: UNIQUE (engagement_id, key)

columns: mailed_at timestamp with time zone null
constraints: fk_moments_engagement: FOREIGN KEY (engagement_id) REFERENCES delivery.engagements(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
pk_moments: PRIMARY KEY (engagement_id, moment)

columns: at timestamp with time zone = now()
constraints: ck_pulses_score: CHECK (((score >= 1) AND (score <= 5)))
fk_pulses_engagement: FOREIGN KEY (engagement_id) REFERENCES delivery.engagements(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
pk_pulses: PRIMARY KEY (id)
uq_pulses_week: UNIQUE (engagement_id, email, week)

columns: updated_at timestamp with time zone = now()
constraints: fk_results_engagement: FOREIGN KEY (engagement_id) REFERENCES delivery.engagements(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
pk_results: PRIMARY KEY (engagement_id, key)

columns: at timestamp with time zone = now()
told_at timestamp with time zone null
constraints: ck_reviews_may_quote: CHECK (((may_quote)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('private'::character varying)::text, ('anonymous'::character varying)::text, ('named'::character varying)::text])))
ck_reviews_score: CHECK (((score IS NULL) OR ((score >= 1) AND (score <= 5))))
fk_reviews_engagement: FOREIGN KEY (engagement_id) REFERENCES delivery.engagements(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
pk_reviews: PRIMARY KEY (id)
uq_reviews_moment: UNIQUE (engagement_id, moment, email)

columns: created_at timestamp with time zone = now()
hidden_at timestamp with time zone null
constraints: fk_updates_engagement: FOREIGN KEY (engagement_id) REFERENCES delivery.engagements(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
fk_updates_milestone: FOREIGN KEY (milestone_id) REFERENCES delivery.milestones(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
pk_updates: PRIMARY KEY (id)

columns: created_at timestamp with time zone = now()
decided_at timestamp with time zone null
constraints: ck_wise_credits_cents: CHECK ((cents > 0))
ck_wise_credits_currency: CHECK (((currency)::text ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$'::text))
ck_wise_credits_matched: CHECK ((((status)::text <> 'matched'::text) OR (invoice_id IS NOT NULL)))

ck_wise_credits_status: CHECK (((status)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('matched'::character varying)::text, ('review'::character varying)::text, ('ignored'::character varying)::text, ('dismissed'::character varying)::text])))
fk_wise_credits_invoice: FOREIGN KEY (invoice_id) REFERENCES delivery.invoices(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
pk_wise_credits: PRIMARY KEY (id)
uq_wise_credits_wise_id: UNIQUE (wise_id)
